title: Tesla's work on electron movement and transmutation
summary: Harold Malmgren tells of Tesla's work on electron movement and transmutation, about early 20th century at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: but I think Tesla anyway was on this track of the movement of electrons allowed repositioning of just about every anything.

plain: Harald Malmgren, a former advisor to US presidents, says on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels that the inventor Nikola Tesla was working on how moving electrons could let you rearrange almost anything. If so, Tesla would have been close to turning one material into another, an idea Malmgren links to the technology he says he saw in UFO material.
